To: jan.thornton@mailbox.example
Replying to: none
Cc: pete.thornton@mailbox.example, carol.rigby@mailbox.example
Subject: Caravan 2027 costs and weeks

Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2027 has come in at £5,087 all in, so that is £1,271.75 each between the four of us. Please can you pay me by 31 January into the usual account, same as last year. The park want the whole lot by then.

If anyone would rather pay in two lots, that's fine. It's £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January. Just let me know.

The weeks are as follows:

Jan 7th to 14th August.
Pete and Linda 29 May to 5 June, which takes in May half term.
Carol Easter week and a week in September.
Me and Bev 5 to 12 June. Handover is on the 5th.

No clashes this year, so that should suit everyone.

Pete, the shower tray. I went up on 26 October and put a new one in. It cost £140 in parts. I'm not putting that on the bill, it's sorted.

Please can everyone make sure the water is turned off at the stop tap when you leave. The park have moaned again.

Also, the park have said caravans over 15 years old will need a condition survey before the 2028 season. Ours is 16 years old, so we'll need one for 2028. I'll sort out the details nearer the time, so nobody's surprised.

Any problems let me know.

Regards
Mick
